notIdeasOfWhatSocietyShouldBe.explanation: The defining sources (the ECPS glossary entry on Turkophobia, Brown's study of far-right framing of Turkey, a study of Balkan memory) describe a hostile attitude toward Turks, Turkish culture and Turkey, and the doctrines it appears in (Christian crusading rhetoric, Arab and Balkan nationalisms, far-right Islamophobia), not a programme of its own. Going through the statements on economy, government, society, world, liberty, culture, ecology, technology, means and globalism, none could be answered from these sources, so fewer than two positions are found.

sources.title: Constructing Turkish Identity as the Other: The Erasure of a Civilization in Balkan Memory (ULAKBIM repository record)
